notes:
Summary: Orbitline is a mid-market SaaS (B2B knowledge search) evaluating Redwood as their embeddings + semantic search backend. They plan to start on Hosted API for dev/POC and migrate to Dedicated for production if unit economics and throughput meet SLAs. Key quote from CTO: 'We need predictable cost at scale — embeddings are our main variable cost.'

Meeting fragments / call notes:
- CTO (R. Chen): wants predictable pricing for nightly bulk runs and sub-50ms vector retrieval latency for interactive product flows.
- Product lead (M. Silva): primary use case is semantic search over user docs + changelogs; also plan summarization in a second phase.
- Engineering: asks re: bulk embedding job (S3 -> Redwood bulk import), retry semantics, and backpressure during peak jobs.
- Security: requests SOC2, SSO (SAML + SCIM), audit logs retention 7 years, and KMS support for customer-managed keys.

Shorthand / CRM style:
- POC: 2-week batch embedding run on hosted -> measure throughput & cost per 1M embeddings
- Metrics wanted: ingest throughput (docs/sec), median embed latency, top-k query latency (ms), mem/CPU usage during batch
- Routing: want fallback to lower-cost quantized model during backfills; can route live queries to Dedicated once rolled out

Stakeholder sentiment: interested but price-sensitive. Will push for Dedicated only if 20-30% savings vs hosted API + SLA for availability.
requirements_summary:
Workload: bulk nightly embedding jobs (S3 -> index), realtime top-k semantic search for product UI.
Scale targets: ~1.2M documents/month, typical daily batch 200k docs, peak batch window 4 hours (target ingest ~14k docs/hour), target sustained embed throughput 1k-2k embeddings/sec during batch windows.
Query targets: 99th p95 p99 retrieval latency under 75ms (p50 < 25ms) for top-10 recall.
Vector DB integration: currently using Pinecone; open to switching to managed vector DB or Redwood-managed connectors. Needs S3 connector + bulk import API.
Model preferences: high-quality text embeddings (open models acceptable), prefer smaller/quantized variants for cheaper nightly runs.
Cost sensitivity: medium-high — want cost per 1M embeddings and projected monthly spend.
poc_plan:
Phase 1 (Hosted API, 2 weeks): run representative batch of 250k docs with Redwood hosted embedding endpoint -> feed to Pinecone. Success criteria: sustained 1k embeddings/sec, p95 embed latency < 400ms, reliable retries, end-to-end cost report.
Phase 2 (Demo Dedicated): if Phase 1 meets perf and cost thresholds, spin up 1-node Dedicated env for parallel test (ingest + query) and compare unit economics.
Deliverables: perf report, cost model (hosted vs dedicated), security checklist, ops runbook for nightly jobs.
pricing_concerns:
Primary concern: unit cost for large-scale nightly embeddings. Orbitline asks for committed pricing tiers for Dedicated and clear burst/overage billing. Wants an apples-to-apples comparison: hosted per-embed vs Dedicated amortized infra + infra management fee.
They also asked: can we offer a 6-12 month bridge pricing for committing early? Sales to propose options in pricing deck.
